header.cleanBody:
You can activate the following effects once each. When this effect discards three cards, this Spirit gains an extra God symbol.
█ By discarding a Red/Purple card from your Hand, this Spirit gains +10000 BP.
█ By discarding a Green/White card from your Hand, this Spirit refreshes.
█ By discarding a Yellow/Blue card from your Hand, the opponent can't use Magic cards.
